metadata.title: Splice formulae for Poincaré series of integral homology spheres
metadata.abstract: Let M be a plumbed integral homology sphere 3-manifold associated with a connected negative definite plumbing graph $\Gamma$. One of its most important invariants is its multivariable Poincaré series (or zeta function) $f_\Gamma(\mathbf {t})$. Several numerical invariants can be read from $f_\Gamma(\mathbf{t})$, or even from its `polynomial part' $ \operatorname{Pol}_{\Gamma}(\mathbf{t})$. For example, the `normalized' Casson's invariant equals $ \operatorname{Pol}_{\Gamma}(1)$. In this note we provide several splice (surgery) formulae for $f_\Gamma$ and $\operatorname{Pol}_\Gamma$ (reduced to the node variables, or to the node variables of connected sub-graphs). In this way, these global invariants can be recovered from a collection of certain smaller graphs. Recall that some (integral homology sphere) 3-manifold invariants are additive with respect to the splice decomposition (like the Casson's invariant). However, some invariants need some `splice correction terms'. In our formulae the correction terms are easily computable one variable Alexander polynomials.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 对负定 plumbing 图对应的整数同调三球，给出多变量 Poincaré 级数及其多项式部分的 splice 手术公式。
analysis.breakthrough: 将整体不变量化为较小图的数据，并用一变量 Alexander 多项式计算拼接修正。
analysis.limitations: 公式适用于指定整数同调球及变量约化情形，不是所有三流形不变量均有无修正可加性。 数学解读仅依据官方摘要与作者评论，尚未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索与命中核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 为低维拓扑不变量提供计算工具，但与当前曲率主线的直接联系较弱。
